definitions.explanation: Turning something to its opposite state — flipping an image, reversing a direction, or inverting a position. Used for physical rotation as well as abstract reversals of situation or trend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{画像|がぞう}→画像：13549_gazou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{反転|はんてん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{左右|さゆう}→左右：02826_sayuu⟧{反転|はんてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I saved the photo with a horizontal flip.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{反転|はんてん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The momentum of the game reversed all at once.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{左右|さゆう}→左右：02826_sayuu⟧{反転|はんてん} (horizontal flip / mirror image)
- ⟦{上下|じょうげ}→上下：04282_jouge⟧{反転|はんてん} (vertical flip)
- {反転|はんてん}{攻勢|こうせい} (turning to the offensive)
- ⟦{白黒|しろくろ}→白黒：13642_shirokuro⟧{反転|はんてん} (black-and-white inversion)

USAGE:
Very common in digital image editing, photography, and design contexts. Also used in sports and news to describe a dramatic turnaround in circumstances. The homophone ⟦{斑点|はんてん}→斑点：06787_hanten⟧ (spot, speckle) is a different word.
